parameter_source_contract.rule: Every runtime parameter must declare current source tier and upgrade rule before being treated as production-ready.

atr_length.source_basis: GainzAlgo supporting evidence states ATR = SMA(True Range, default 14), which is sufficient to freeze ATR(14) as the v1 default input length.
atr_length.upgrade_rule: Keep 14 as the v1 ATR input length unless a later audited source or implementation binding explicitly requires a different ATR core definition.

atr_baseline_length.source_basis: GainzAlgo supporting evidence states that Baseline ATR uses a long-period average with default 50 bars.
atr_baseline_length.upgrade_rule: Keep 50 as the v1 frozen baseline unless a later audited source requires a different baseline definition and triggers a new version.

atr_percentile_window.source_basis: CHE evidence confirms ATR percentile must use a rolling window but does not freeze a single default length; Batch9 v1 freezes 252 as the cross-asset comparison window for the first runtime contract.
atr_percentile_window.upgrade_rule: Keep 252 in v1 for comparability; if a later code-level audited source freezes another window, open a new version instead of silently changing v1.

squeeze_mode.source_basis: Current mode is intentionally labeled as TTM-Pro-like to reflect source-inspired behavior without claiming a full source-identical engine.
squeeze_mode.upgrade_rule: If later bound to a specific TTM variant, record the exact variant name and keep v1 as the source-inspired placeholder contract.
